children: said on Monday it proposes to issue notes under its global medium-term note programme and will provide potential investors with recent corporate and financial information related to the offering.

The proposed offering comprises senior unsecured notes denominated in US dollars and offshore Chinese yuan, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters. The notes will be issued under the company's global medium-term note programme.
